_README: REVIEWED PER-COMPANY DIFFERENCES. ONE SYSTEM, TWO ORGANISATIONS (owner,
2026-08-18): 两个公司不是用着同一个系统吗？他们只是 Multi-Organization 关系而已啊.
A company may legitimately have its own DATA - its documents, its numbering
prefix, its branding - and a very small number of RULES THE OWNER STATED
HIMSELF. It may not have different CAPABILITIES by accident.
backend/scripts/check-company-divergence.mjs finds lines that NAME a company.
A regex cannot tell a stated rule from an accident, so this file is where a
person records the judgement. Every entry needs a `why` that would survive
being read out loud AND a `whoSetIt` naming whose decision it was - the second
field is the one that matters here, because the owner's position is that a
per-company difference is legitimate only when he set it. 'Historical' and
'legacy' are not people. A line not listed here FAILS the build.
Keyed by file plus normalized line TEXT, never by line number, so a merge that
moves a branch keeps its review and an EDIT to a branch re-opens it.
Entries whose line is gone are reported as STALE and printed, never failed - a
gate that punishes somebody for REMOVING a per-company branch is a gate that
stops the work. Clear them anyway.
THE TWO ENTRIES WORTH RE-READING BEFORE ANY SWEEP, because they are real
capability differences and not branding:
- frontend/src/auth/AuthGate.tsx - the mobile build exists for the base
company only (owner: 2990 手机关闭).
- backend/src/scm/lib/so-po-lock.ts - the SO-PO edit lock applies to 2990
orders only, scoped by doc-number prefix (owner, 2026-08-12).
WHAT IS NOT IN HERE, and cannot be: a config row one company lacks, a column
one importer never writes, and a status list that only ever matches one
company's rows. The gate cannot see any of those. See its header.
